close_reason: Won't fix: P4-opinion-only stylistic refactor. Per AGENTS.md convergence rule, P4/opinion findings under a converged review epic are bikeshedding-threshold. The current 'pub(crate) mod test_support' is #[cfg(test)], has a clear module-level doc comment explaining the std::sync::Mutex choice, and works correctly. The original '886 LoC' observation is also stale: lib.rs has since grown to 2104 LoC, dominated by non-test code. Defer to a future test-harness refactor if/when integration-test layout (JMAP-sc1b.16-style) gets revisited.
description:
src/lib.rs:177 declares 'pub(crate) mod test_support'. Sister files calendar.rs:241, event.rs:689, event_notification.rs:191, participant_identity.rs:213, principal.rs:108 all import via 'use crate::test_support::MockBackend'. This works but lives inside lib.rs, making lib.rs 886 LoC of which ~250 are test infrastructure.

Cleaner option (idiomatic for Rust testing): move test_support into its own file at src/test_support.rs and make it a #[cfg(test)] sibling module. Or, more idiomatic still, move it to tests/common/mod.rs as a shared integration-test helper — but that requires the integration test pattern, which this crate doesn't have (PLAN.md §Test Strategy describes 'tests/' directory — see JMAP-sc1b.16 which already flags this).

The current arrangement is also unusual in that all unit tests are inline in their respective module files but share a test_support module via crate::. Pulling test_support out to its own file would make the structure read more naturally.

P4 / opinion: the current setup compiles and works. The proposed changes are stylistic. May coordinate with future integration-test work tracked in JMAP-sc1b.16.
title: test_support::MockBackend exposed as pub(crate) but tests in sibling files import via crate::test_support — cleaner path exists
